name: TaskMate - Minimal Productive Task Manager
tagline: A simple, clean, distraction-free task manager for daily focus.
blurb: TaskMate helps you stay organized with a clean, minimalistic interface.
description:
TaskMate helps you stay organized with a clean, minimalistic interface.
Features include:
• Add, edit, delete, and archive tasks
• Auto-sort completed tasks
• Beautiful Material Design
• Multilingual support (English & Persian)
• Dark mode
• Swipe actions with animations
• Timestamped tasks with smart formatting

Focus on what matters — distraction-free.
